title: Headless worktree creation has no config path for a default sidebar folder
description:
Split out of THE-696 (2026-09-29). THE-696 delivered `thegn wt folder <worktree> <name>` and `thegn wt new --folder <name>`, but no config default.

THE-696 originally asked for `[[worktree_templates]].folder`. That would be dead config: `WorktreeTemplate` is not referenced anywhere under `crates/thegn-host/src/cmd/`; headless creation has no template selection.

This issue is the remaining convenience: a default so a caller that does not pass `--folder` still gets its worktree filed.

Options considered:
1. A plain key (e.g. a `default_folder` key in the table `wt new` already reads its defaults from) that headless creation reads directly. Simplest; needs no template selection.
2. `[[worktree_templates]].folder` — requires first defining how `wt new` selects a template.
3. A pipeline-level default — note `session open --stage` does not create a worktree.

## Acceptance criteria
- A worktree created headlessly with no `--folder` is filed according to the configured default.
- An explicit `--folder` overrides the default.
- Repo-scoped like folders; find-or-create still yields one folder across repeated runs.
- An empty/whitespace-only configured name is refused at config validation, not at creation time.
- The new key is covered by the config ratchets (`config.toml.example` key coverage, the env overlay, the completion slot).
